source_ref.production_note: Episode 12 of the '토스 숨은 서비스' (Toss hidden services) feature-tutorial series. Vertical 1080x1920, ~59.28s, 29.97fps, 1775 frames. Structure: a short handheld live-action presenter intro (a young female 'Toss Onboarding Coordinator' walking through a wood-paneled office/cafe and picking up a phone), then a long single continuous physical-phone-in-hand screen demo of the in-app year-end-tax 'pre-check' (연말정산 사전점검) flow with step-numbered torn-paper captions (badges 1-6), and a live-action presenter outro sign-off. Same female presenter narrates throughout. The phone status-bar clock advances 3:55 -> 3:56 -> 3:57 across the demo, confirming one continuous real-device take; the operator does a gentle push-in to a closer phone framing around the results screen (~30.4s).

target_demo: 연말정산을 하는 20대 후반~30대 직장인(급여소득자), MZ 세대
narrative_arc: A relatable seasonal premise opens (a presenter says she pre-checks how much she should spend before year-end tax), then the video resolves it as a step-by-step in-app demonstration: open the app, go to the All tab, search the year-end-tax pre-check feature, enter expected salary, consent and wait while the app calculates, then read the estimated card income-deduction and pension tax-credit results (how much more to spend / contribute to maximize the refund), close on a legal caveat and a warm series sign-off promising to return with more hidden tips.
creative_device: employee-guided 'hidden feature' walkthrough: a friendly Toss staffer demonstrates a lesser-known in-app tool on a real phone, with step-numbered torn-paper captions kept in lockstep with the voiceover; seasonal year-end-tax hook frames the utility.

production_signature.signature_note: Two live-action framing modes: (1) handheld documentary-style live-action presenter bookends (intro walk + lean, outro lean) with gentle natural camera drift, shallow depth and motion blur on movement; (2) a long near-locked handheld take of a real iPhone (Dynamic Island, status bar 3:55-3:57, LTE) held in hand against a softly blurred warm-amber office background, the phone screen filmed directly so glass glare, micro hand-drift and real finger taps are visible; around the results screen the operator gently pushes the phone closer to camera (larger framing) without a hard cut. Wiggle metric mean_abs_shift_x ~0.1447 with sign_flips ~0.244 = ordinary handheld micro-motion, NOT a lenticular wiggle_3d effect. No 3D/AI/parallax capture signature.

global_layout.layout_note: Demo segments center the held phone vertically in frame inside a soft warm bokeh surround; instructional captions live in a fixed lower-center band rendered as torn-paper / masking-tape lozenges (white, slightly skewed) with key words in Toss-blue and a circled blue step-number badge to the upper-left of the band (badges 1-6). Intro/outro center the presenter slightly off-center with a two-line hand-drawn marker-highlighted blue title box at the top (intro) or lower-center (outro), and the intro adds a lower-third name tag (English role line + Korean name in a blue box). The Korean text-heavy lower caption system is the dominant graphic layer over otherwise clean live-action and clean UI.

recreation_prompts.t2i_start_frame: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 commercial still of a Korean woman in her mid-to-late twenties, seen from the waist up, captured mid-stride as she walks through and then begins to lean against a counter inside a warm, modern wood-paneled office lounge. Subject and pose: she has a chin-length reddish-brown bob with soft side-swept bangs that catch the warm light, light natural 'no-makeup' makeup, smooth lightly-retouched skin, and a calm friendly half-smile; her head is tipped slightly down and to the side as she is glancing toward a smartphone she is lifting into both hands at chest height, body angled at roughly three-quarters to camera, weight shifting onto one leg as she settles. Wardrobe and material: a relaxed oversized olive-green ribbed-knit crewneck sweater with a slightly fuzzy soft matte cotton/wool surface and visible chunky rib texture at the cuffs and collar, paired with light-blue straight-leg jeans in a soft worn denim, and a thin white lanyard around her neck holding a clear plastic ID-badge holder that carries a small generic rounded mascot illustration (no real logo); a slim white notebook or laptop is tucked under one arm. Location and set: a cozy company kitchenette/lounge with light honey-wood slat ceiling beams running overhead, pale matte upper cabinets, a wood-topped counter behind her cluttered with colorful office stationery standing in holders, a few small boxes, a white tissue box and stacked papers, and a frosted translucent-glass partition at the left edge; the whole background falls into soft creamy warm bokeh, the depth compressing the clutter into pleasant amber blobs. Foreground and props: the smartphone (the hero tool of the coming tutorial) and the white notebook read as her work-life props, framing her as a real staffer. Lighting setup: soft and warm at roughly 3000K, a gentle broad top key from overhead practical downlights skims her hair and shoulders, moderate ambient bounce fills the shadow side at about a 2:1 key-to-fill ratio, there is no hard rim, and the result is soft short shadows under the chin and a mid-key, low-contrast, inviting exposure with no clipped highlights. Lens, framing and camera angle: a handheld documentary medium shot at roughly a 35mm-equivalent field of view, shot at eye level, the subject placed centered-to-right-third with generous warm negative space on the opposite side, a moderate-to-shallow depth of field keeping her sharp while the room melts behind. Composition and grid: a loose center grid with the figure offset for breathing room, the caption zone reserved at top and lower-third. Color palette and strategy: analogous and warm-dominant — amber wood #9a6b3f as the environmental ground, the muted olive sweater #4d5a3a as the subject anchor, neutral cabinet beige #d8cdbf as the mid-tone bridge, and a dark #2f3a44 as the shadow anchor, with a single saturated Toss-blue #3182f6 accent reserved exclusively for the on-screen caption box (about 15% of the frame). Texture and surfaces: soft fuzzy cotton/wool knit, polished honey wood, glossy plastic stationery, frosted glass at the edge, and natural skin. Atmosphere: a clean cozy interior with shallow-depth haze, a soft warm ambient glow, gentle motion blur on her moving arm and trailing hair, no smoke and no film grain. Post and signature look: clean digital, warm grade, mid-key, slightly lifted shadows, true-to-life skin — ordinary handheld micro-motion, no lenticular or 3D parallax effect. Overlay, preserved verbatim as on-screen graphics: a two-line marker-highlighted blue title box pinned across the top reading '연말정산 최대로 돌려 받으려면?' on the first line and '토스로 미리 점검하기' on the second, with the word '연말정산' encircled by a hand-drawn yellow ellipse; and a lower-third name tag with an English role line 'Toss Onboarding Coodinator' above a Korean name '최유정' set inside a small Toss-blue rounded box. These captions are normally finalized in post but are preserved here for fidelity. Style anchor: a clean 4K vertical Korean social-commercial documentary aesthetic, natural and approachable, hi-key-leaning warm grade, Korean fintech brand-film look.
